reason: The README clearly describes an orchestration plugin that adds a second-model reviewer to tool approval requests, applies configurable allow, deny, delegate, and never policies, and records review outcomes in the session log.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的工具审批链增加只读的第二模型审查器，根据配置返回允许、拒绝或委托结果并记录审查事件。
summaries.en: Adds a read-only second-model reviewer to DeepSeek Harness tool approvals, applying configurable allow, deny, delegate, and never policies with logged review outcomes.

capabilities: Intercepts approval requests in the DeepSeek Harness answerer chain
Uses a reviewer subagent with read, glob, and grep tools to assess requests
Can allow, deny, delegate, or reject configured tool requests
Injects reviewer decisions and reasons into tool results
Writes auditable auto-review verdict and rejection events to the session log
Provides session commands and an optional web review panel for review state and overrides
